response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with deep full-stack and open-source experience, but he falls short on two hard requirements for this executive leadership role: German proficiency is listed as basic (C1 minimum required), and his career shows no formal team leadership, technical project management, or client advisory experience at the level the role demands. Python and UML expertise are also absent from his skill set.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-performance systems
Genuine open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, multiple libraries, FOSS4G talk) and strong Linux background
Proven mentoring/knowledge-sharing ability through workshops, courses, and coding dojos
concerns: German language listed as 'Basic' — role requires minimum C1
No formal team leadership, executive, or technical project management roles in career history
No demonstrated Python or UML proficiency, both listed as desired/required skills

key_factors.factor: German language gap (Basic vs. required C1)
Lack of formal leadership/management track record
Strong open-source and broad engineering background
